scoring_justification: Exact contact angle values depend on MD implementation details; we verify the non-monotonic trend shape and cavity density threshold crossing which are re-derivable from the simulation protocol.

outputs.description: CSV file containing the computed apparent contact angle and cavity water density for each microstructure period. The non-monotonic shape of contact angle vs. normalized period and the cavity density threshold between Cassie and Wenzel regimes are evaluated.

output_contract.notes: The CSV must contain at least 5 rows covering a range of normalized period λ/r_B from ~0 to >0.8, corresponding to the microstructure periods specified in the reproduction target.
